entities.name: Korean War
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: War between North Korea (backed by China and USSR) and South Korea (backed by UN/US forces) from 1950 to 1953. It ended in an armistice with the peninsula still divided along the 38th parallel, setting the template for Cold War proxy conflicts.
